name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Toggle buttons sharing one selection — single or multiple, horizontal or vertical.

meta.whenToUse: An immediate view or scope switch over the same content (Mine | Team, Grid | List) — pass deselectable={false} so one item always stays pressed — or related toggle buttons such as formatting; wrap lets a long option set fall onto rows on a narrow screen.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form value (RadioGroup), swapping page regions (Tabs), moving between URLs (links), or a single on/off control (Toggle/Switch).
